description: This script manages authorization directories and files for different providers within a Dockerized environment, including functions to trim, normalize, and collect authorization directories and files based on overrides, CSV inputs, or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_trim
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from input string.

methods.name: openclaw_live_normalize_auth_dir
methods.description: Normalizes a directory string by trimming and prepending a dot.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_dir_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the authorization directory name for a given provider.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_file_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the authorization file name for a given provider.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_csv
methods.description: Collects and outputs authorization directories based on a CSV list of providers.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_override
methods.description: Collects authorization directories based on override environment variable settings.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs
methods.description: Main entry to collect authorization directories, considering overrides or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_csv
methods.description: Collects and outputs authorization files based on a CSV list of providers.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_override
methods.description: Collects authorization files based on override environment variable settings.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files
methods.description: Main entry to collect authorization files, considering overrides or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_join_csv
methods.description: Joins multiple values into a CSV string.
